verdict.rationale: The evidence pack describes Grafana Alerting sending notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie (grafana-gh-7) and general 'take action on alerts' language (grafana-docs-24/25), but nowhere does it explicitly document a generic webhook contact point or integration designed to trigger automated remediation scripts/agents. Missing for 10: explicit webhook contact-point documentation, examples of webhook payloads triggering automation, and any mention of agent/remediation-triggering integration via alerts.
